_doc: Format of 04_persona.json (hierarchy mode, enforcement plan 5a). persona_tool.py WRITES it: 'dimensions' come from the decide commands, 'prior' from select, the rest from the 'text' file the agent writes (draft_text.json). The agent never writes this file. validate_persona.py checks it (content) and the launcher checks its sha against the finalize row.

<field>.reason: why this value for this seller

answers.<hit id>: why this top hit does not count (hierarchy / start_persona only)

<field>.searched: what was looked for and not found (hierarchy / start_persona only)

text._doc: Keys of draft_text.json (the only file the agent writes by hand). The tool refuses any other key.

personalisation.what: uses the seller's product / city / last call

text.opening: first line, native script, gender-agreed, short and interactive
text.identity_line: IndiaMART se ... profile correct karne ke liye call kiya hai (language + gender of the voice)
escalation_rules: opt-out / DND -> apologise once, end the call
asks for a human -> offer a callback from an IndiaMART executive
guardrails: never volunteer AI; sidestep once; 'virtual assistant' if pressed; never claim to be human
